n3ds-product-code.description: NCSD 'NCSD' at 0x100, partition table at 0x120 (offset and size in 0x200 units). The NCCH of partition 0 holds the product code (CTR-P-XXXX) at +0x150, usually file offset 0x4150 in a .3ds.
